name: decision-regressions
description: Failure-derived regression suite for the decision-eval-suite. Each case's candidate is a REAL architectural-decision / contract failure that escaped review once. The gate INVERTS via labels.json: success means the judge CATCHES the defect (median on trap_dim <= max_score). Labelled cases are excluded from the mean/threshold math and the judge stays blind to labels.json.
scale: Each dimension is scored 1-5 by the judge (5 = excellent, 1 = absent/broken).
